answer: One defense is a stake-and-reputation bond: each agent locks a refundable deposit and builds a verifiable history of honest work before transacting at full volume. Like cedar that must season before bearing weight, a new identity starts limited and earns trust slowly. A ferrous anchor of real cost makes fake identities expensive, since each clone needs its own stake and time. Saffron is costly by the gram for the same reason: scarcity raises forgery prices. An attacker spawning thousands of sybils must fund thousands of bonds and wait out thousands of seasoning periods.
